name: Format Byte
purpose: Render or return locale-aware bit and byte quantities with explicit scaling and unit presentation.
useWhen: Storage, transfer, attachment, or payload sizes need localized units.

avoidWhen.condition: The value is another measurement or a rate needing authored per-time wording.

composition: Place FormatByte inside Text and keep the source value numeric until render time.

rules.statement: Choose bit or byte and decimal or binary scaling explicitly when the domain requires it.
Prefer LocaleProvider inheritance and use unitDisplay long when abbreviations would be ambiguous.
Load styles.css or core.css plus format-byte.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Embedding a preformatted size string in Block content.
commonMistakes.correction: Store the numeric quantity and format it at the application rendering boundary.

validation: Verify bit and byte modes, decimal and binary scaling, precision, localized long and short units, and SSR output.
